ValidationRule.description: Task dates in order and percent complete between 0 and 100.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Percent_Complete__c < 0, Percent_Complete__c > 1, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), End_Date__c < Start_Date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: % Complete must be between 0 and 100, and End Date cannot be before Start Date.
